page.overview:
Who is Brian Gearlooski?

Brian Gearlooski is a character in the world of Cars 2. He is Rip Clutchgoneski's pit crew chief. He does not appear in the film and was only depicted as a figure in the Cars 2 Die-Cast Line.

He didn't appear in the movie, but he appears as a die-cast in 2016-2020.
